changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce cb_enquiry status allowed values at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_cb_enquiry ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_cb_enquiry_status CHECK (status IS NULL OR status IN ('INITIATED', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCESS', 'NO_HIT', 'FAILED', 'DATA_MISMATCH'))

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce cb_attribute category allowed values at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_cb_attribute ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_cb_attribute_category CHECK (category IN ('ADDITIONAL_SUMMARY_ATTRIBUTES', 'PERFORM_ATTRIBUTES'))
